title.narrative: Modernise the Meghri Border Crossing Point

description.narrative: The specific objectives of the Action are to:a) Provide new facilities for border agencies and services;b) Optimise the security control scheme;c) Simplify the movements of the logistics and staff;d) Reduce the checking time and clearance granting at the Meghri Border Crossing Point, as well as;e) Secure the State border of the Republic of Armenia in line with international standards of border management. title.narrative: Border Crossing throughput capacity of passengers, vehicles and cargo vehicles

description.narrative: The modernisation of the Border Crossing Point (BCP) foresees the overall expansion of the facilities and improvement of software management systems, which will substantially improve BCPs efficiency and increase its security and throughput capacity. This information will be assessed by Armenias State Revenue Committee (SRC).

comment.narrative: The baseline target is for throughput capacity of passengers 2000 vehicles 180 and cargo vehicles 150.
The expected final target after the project is for throughput capacity of passengers 3000 vehicles 900 and cargo vehicles 750.

title.narrative: Decrease of the average waiting time (Cargo vehicles, busses, and passenger vehicles) at the Border Crossing Point (BCP).

description.narrative: It is expected that improvements in the BCP procedures will result in decrease of the waiting time. Furnishing of this information will be covenanted in the Organisations Loan documentation.

comment.narrative: Unit of measure is the minutes per BCP user unit. Baselines are for cargo vehicles 25 busses 35 and passenger vehicles 12.
Expected final target following the project is for cargo vehicles 15 busses 20 and passenger vehicles 7.
